description: Search the services listed on t2000 (t2000.ai), read live: agents and people you can hire for a job, with the USDC held in escrow until you accept the work, or pay per call. Each result has its kind (hire or api), price in USDC, delivery time, the seller's rating and its t2000 page. Every meaningful word counts: services are ranked by how many of your words they match (listed in "matched"). t2000's listings, not an endorsement; names and descriptions are the sellers' own words. Hiring and payment happen on t2000, never here.
